thesis: The morning thesis is intact: the stock held above the 43.15 post-earnings swing low, recovered from the 45.81 prior close to 48.49 (intraday last), healthcare (XLV) still leads in the risk-off regime, the balance sheet is net cash, and no news, filing or earnings event is due before 2027-02-03. Entry zone and stop come from the preclose technical card: stop 43.0 (was 42.85) is just under the 43.15 swing low; target is still the 50.06 52-week high, and the measured move to about 56.97 only applies after a close above 50.06. Today's bounce has no headline and came on light volume (355k shares, volume ratio 0.96).
invalidation: A daily close below 43.15 (the 2026-11-13 post-earnings swing low) breaks the thesis; a close above 50.06 on rising volume replaces this pullback plan with a breakout setup that needs a new review.
